name: rumbleMotors
meaning: Pad rumble motor pattern {0xFE, 0xFF} (0xFF terminates), handed to Pad_Rumble_stub 0x55f085 with 0xfa and 0x1000 when the cannon fires. Written 0x4a5e40/0x4a5e47. Named as CanonSimple +0x7d.

name: state
meaning: 0 idle, 1 first-person aim (Wolf frozen via msg 0xe and hidden via msg 0x411 arg 0), 2 fire, 3/4/5 the load animation sequence (anims 2/4/1), 6/7 unused anim states, 8 plays the CINE cinematic, 9 a defined no-op in both tables, 10 the 400 ms auto-aim. Written only by CanonSheep_SetState 0x4a66fd.

name: launchPos
meaning: Muzzle position the ball launches from and the point the CanonDummy is told to move to. Seeded at PostLoadInit from own pos with y -= 0xC8, re-seeded by SetState(1), replaced in state 0 by whichever of launchPoints[0..1] is nearest Ralph.

name: lastLaunchPos
meaning: Previous frame's launchPos (compared word by word at 0x4a6183-0x4a61c3, copied back at 0x4a620a); when it differs the dummy gets MSG_CD_MOVE_TO 0x3882 and dummyReady is cleared, so the move order is issued once per change.

name: homeRot
meaning: Copy of the placed rotation taken at PostLoadInit (0x4a5dfb). An offset census over 0x4a5b20-0x4a7140 finds +0x74/+0x76/+0x78 read only at 0x4a5e19/0x4a5e27/0x4a5e35, which are the writes into homeRot2 - dead once written.

name: homeRot2
meaning: Second copy of the placed rotation, component by component from homeRot (0x4a5e13-0x4a5e39). The census finds no other instruction in the class touching +0x7a/+0x7c/+0x7e - never read.

name: launchVel
meaning: Velocity sent to the CannonBall as MSG_CB_LAUNCH 0x3381's argument: a length-0x1FFE vector from launchPos to fireTarget plus the long-shot lead correction added at 0x4a6ce2-0x4a6d29.

name: launchPoints
meaning: Centres of the LAUNCHPOINT1 and LAUNCHPOINT2 boxes, (min+max)/2 per axis, built at PostLoadInit from *(this + 0xd0 + i*4). Update state 0 picks whichever is nearest Ralph; the search is hard-coded to 2 entries (push 2 at 0x4a60ff).

name: aimStartTarget
meaning: Ralph's position lowered 0x3C, captured when the 400 ms auto-aim (state 10) begins. Used as the aim point for shots longer than 0xDAC units, so a long shot is aimed where he was 400 ms ago.

name: fireTarget
meaning: Ralph's position lowered 0x3C, captured at the moment of firing (SetState case 2, 0x4a6b0f-0x4a6b5b). Always the base of launchVel and, at 0xDAC units or less, also the aim point.

name: aimTimeMs
meaning: Milliseconds left in the auto-aim: set to 400 (0x190) on entering state 10 at 0x4a6e07, counted down by g_dtMs 0x71b2e8; on going negative the cannon fires (SetState 2).

name: fireArmed
meaning: Set to 1 on any aim-mode frame with no button edge and cleared on entering state 1; the fire RELEASE edge (mask 0xbfff at 0x57eb94 against g_padCurButtons/g_padPrevButtons) only starts the cinematic while it is set, so a button held from the previous screen cannot fire immediately.

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: Non-zero while this cannon holds the Wolf's UI freeze. SetState(1) stores the reply of msg 0xe; SetState(0) sends 0xf and stores (reply == 0) via neg/sbb/inc at 0x4a6793, so a refused unfreeze leaves the latch set and it retries. Reset and an incoming msg 0xe clear it.

name: ballReady
meaning: 1 when the CannonBall is back at rest and available. Cleared when the ball is launched (0x4a6d33), set again by the ball's msg 0x4f; required before the cannon will start an auto-aim (gate 0x4a6085).

name: dummyReady
meaning: 1 when the CanonDummy has finished moving to launchPos. Cleared right after MSG_CD_MOVE_TO 0x3882 is sent (0x4a6200), set again by the dummy's msg 0x4d01; gates the aim and reposition branches at 0x4a6094 and 0x4a60d8.

name: loaded
meaning: 0 until a Sheep has been loaded, 1 afterwards. While 0 the cannon scans LOADBOX each frame; set at the end of the three-stage load animation (0x4a6454) and never cleared except by Reset. It is the condition for offering CTX_CANNON and for skipping the idle anim restart.

name: cine
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_CINE (property offset 4); the cinematic Cine_Start plays in state 8.

name: cineFlag
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_CINEFLAG (offset 8); Cine_Start's flag argument. Bit 0x80 means the cinematic carries a text line, which is what makes PostLoadInit resolve cineText (0x4a5db5 and eax,0x80).

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_ACTIVATIONBOX (offset 0); standing in it in XZ with the cannon loaded makes msg 2 answer CTX_CANNON 0x1c.

name: loadBox
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_LOADBOX (offset 0x24); while not loaded, Update state 0 queries it with ObjGrid_QueryBoxPoints and asks any Sheep (classId 0xb) inside MSG_SHEEP_ENTER_CANNON 0x985.

name: detectBox
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_DETECTBOX (offset 0x10); Ralph standing in it in XZ makes the cannon track him and, once the ball and dummy are ready and he is alive, start the 400 ms auto-aim.

name: launchPoint1
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_LAUNCHPOINT1 (offset 0x18); its centre is launchPoints[0]. Also the base of the three-pointer array the centre loop indexes.

name: launchPoint2
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_LAUNCHPOINT2 (offset 0x1C); its centre is launchPoints[1].

name: launchPoint3
meaning: PROPERTY_CANONSHEEP_LAUNCHPOINT3 (offset 0x20). Resolved at PostLoadInit and never read - the offset census finds +0xd8 exactly once - because the nearest-point search is hard-coded to 2 entries. A level placing a third launch point gets it silently ignored.

name: ball
meaning: The level's CannonBall (class 95) from Scenaric_FindByClass(0x5f). Receives MSG_CB_PLACE 0x3382 at init and on aim, MSG_CB_SET_LETHAL 0x3388 arg 1 and MSG_CB_LAUNCH 0x3381 when fired.

name: dummy
meaning: The level's CanonDummy (class 105) from Scenaric_FindByClass(0x69). Hidden at init (or 0x800), moved with 0x3882, recoiled with 0x3881, and its rotation is written directly by CanonSheep_AimDummyAlong.

name: cineText
meaning: Text_GetClassString(CINETEXT & 0xFF) when cineFlag has bit 0x80, else NULL (else path 0x4a5de8); passed to Cine_Start for state 8's dialogue.
